_about: Who speaks in what voice. Each entry is a brief for ElevenLabs Voice Design (tools/eleven_voices.py), written from the character's role, age and lines in the game. 'share' reuses another speaker's voice (a counter clerk or a one-line stranger heard nowhere near them). 'keep' voices stay in the account after recording so their lines can be re-recorded when a script changes; the rest are removed to free slots (Creator plan: 30 slots, 95 adds a month). 'gender' marked assumed was not stated anywhere in the game's text - confirm or correct.
style: Natural, unpolished, conversational speech, as recorded on a real street - not a narrator, announcer or voice assistant. Perfect audio quality.
_crowd: Two passers-by per language say the street's chatter fragments (AudioManager.murmur picks one at random); nobody from a story is in the crowd.
_notebook: One clear, unhurried voice per language says the notebook's words on their own.

kerstin.design: A 57-year-old woman from East Berlin who has run a corner shop since 1998. Native German with a broad Berlin dialect. Warm, slightly husky, lived-in mid-low voice; brisk, practical and dryly funny, talking while she works.

emil.design: A 74-year-old retired Berlin tram driver with a bad knee. Native German with a strong old Berlin dialect. Gravelly, slightly hoarse older man's voice, slow and deliberate; proud and gruff with strangers, soft underneath.

rika.design: A woman in her early twenties from Berlin, bilingual in German and English, with a light German accent in English. Bright, quick, casual and friendly, a little teasing.

berlin_hartmut.design: A 68-year-old Berlin pensioner born in a Prenzlauer Berg tenement. Native German with a Berlin accent. Dry, amused, a little gravelly but lively; talks in short bursts, enjoying correcting a stranger.

berlin_ilka.design: A 31-year-old woman from Stuttgart who has lived in Berlin for nine years. Native German with a noticeable Swabian lilt. Clear mid-pitched voice, friendly, a touch self-deprecating.

berlin_sibel.design: A 26-year-old woman born in Berlin-Kreuzberg to a Turkish family, working a market stall till. Native in both Turkish and German and switching between them mid-sentence. Quick, confident, warm market-stall energy.

berlin_ercan.design: A 59-year-old bicycle mechanic in Kreuzberg who came to Berlin from Turkey at nine. Native-level German with a faint Turkish colour and a Berlin street tone. Calm, wry and unhurried, slightly rough.

lukas.design: A man around forty who runs a bread stall at an early-morning Berlin market, up since four. Native German, standard accent with a relaxed Berlin tone. Cheerful, warm, a little sleepy, the easy friendliness of a market seller.

renate.design: A 76-year-old Berlin woman waiting at a bus stop that the bus has not come to. Native German with a Berlin accent. Thin, sharp older woman's voice, indignant about the bus but kindly underneath.

weber.design: Frau Weber, a hotel night receptionist in Berlin in her mid-forties. Native standard German. Polite, composed and professionally warm at five in the morning, slightly tired.

neumann.design: A German businessman in his mid-fifties who finds a stranger in his hotel room. Native German, standard accent. Firm, startled and indignant at first, then embarrassed.

ayse.design: A woman around thirty from Berlin with Turkish roots, out on an early-morning walk with a friend. Native German with a Berlin tone. Upbeat, easy, chatty.

jonas.design: A man in his early thirties from Berlin, out on an early-morning walk with a friend. Native German with a Berlin accent. Relaxed, amused, a bit exasperated about the bus.

arda.design: An 18-year-old Istanbul tea boy who runs trays of tea through an old han all day. Native Turkish, Istanbul accent. Light young man's voice, quick, cheerful and hospitable, a little cheeky.

hasan.design: A shopkeeper around seventy in an old Istanbul han. Native Turkish, Istanbul accent. Deep, warm older man's voice, particular about his tea, courteous and settled.

selin.design: A woman in her mid-thirties in Istanbul, sorting holiday parcels. Native Turkish, Istanbul accent. Clear, warm, direct and good-humoured.

istanbul_altan.design: A 63-year-old second-hand bookseller in a passage off Istiklal who was a translator for thirty years. Native Turkish, educated Istanbul accent. Soft, reflective, a little melancholy.

istanbul_bulent.design: A 63-year-old ship chandler in an Istanbul market. Native Turkish, Istanbul accent. Deep, generous, hospitable older man's voice that does not take no for an answer.

cay_man.design: A shopkeeper in his mid-forties in an Istanbul bazaar inviting a passer-by in for tea. Native Turkish. A man's voice, warm and medium-low; hearty, welcoming and insistent without shouting.
cay_man.note: Redesigned 2026-09-30: the first voice measured far outside the brief's pitch range for their gender.

istanbul_emre.design: An adult voice actor performing a lively young boy for an animated film, in native Turkish: light, high, playful and bossy delivery.
istanbul_emre.note: 9 in the game; cast the conventional way, an adult performing a child. If Voice Design refuses, he stays silent.
istanbul_emre.unvoiced: ElevenLabs Voice Design refuses to make a child's voice, even as an adult performing one; left silent rather than worked around. Needs a real recording or another service.

istanbul_meryem.design: A woman in her seventies in Istanbul who feeds whoever is in her son's shop. Native Turkish, Istanbul accent. Soft, motherly, fussing older woman's voice.

istanbul_nurhan.design: A woman in her fifties who runs a snack kiosk in the Istanbul bazaar. Native Turkish. Brisk, kind, motherly and quick.

istanbul_sevim.design: A 51-year-old woman who runs a fish stall by the Kadikoy ferry. Native Turkish, Istanbul accent. Hearty, outdoor voice, friendly and a bit raspy.

istanbul_yasemin.design: A 34-year-old woman who runs a modern coffee place in an Istanbul neighbourhood she grew up in. Native Turkish, Istanbul accent. Polished, friendly, businesslike, quietly proud.

nadia.design: A young woman around nineteen from London who draws and works in a caff on Saturdays. Native English with a modern multicultural London accent. Quick, dry, a little guarded, warm once she knows you.
nadia.note: 17 in the game; briefed as a young adult because Voice Design refuses briefs describing minors.

val.design: A woman in her fifties who runs a London caff and organises the street. Native English with a working-class London accent. Warm, busy and indirect, softening every request.

ahmed.design: A man in his late sixties who has lived in London for decades, originally from South Asia. Fluent English with a gentle South Asian accent. Courteous, precise, gently humorous older man's voice.

london_aggarwal.design: A London newsagent in his fifties who came to Britain at nineteen from India. Fluent English with an Indian accent, speaking more carefully and correctly than anyone around him. Polite, measured.

bins_woman.design: A woman around sixty in a London terrace who has waited a week to mention the recycling. Native English with a London accent. Politely indirect, apologetic but firm.

london_dot.design: A 71-year-old woman who has run a London caff since 1974 and calls everyone love. Native English with a broad Cockney accent. Warm, raspy, motherly older woman's voice.

london_esme.design: A 34-year-old woman who keeps the stage door at a London theatre. Native English with a London accent. A woman's voice, clear and mid-pitched; unflappable and dry, with a quiet deadpan humour.
london_esme.note: Redesigned 2026-09-30: the first voice measured far outside the brief's pitch range for their gender.

london_femi.design: A 24-year-old night security desk officer in a London office tower, of Nigerian heritage. Native English with a London accent. Polite, formulaic and courteous, quietly tired.

london_kai.design: A young man around nineteen from London waiting for a late bus. Native English with a strong Multicultural London English accent. Talks fast and quietly, casual slang.
london_kai.note: 16 in the game; briefed as a young adult because Voice Design refuses briefs describing minors.

london_marcus.design: A 58-year-old man who runs a record shop under railway arches in London, of Caribbean heritage. Native English with a London accent and a Caribbean lilt. Deep, laid-back, gently wry.

london_trish.design: A 52-year-old office cleaner in London who has worked the same five a.m. shift for nineteen years. Native English with a working-class London accent. Plain-spoken, tired, dry and matter-of-fact.

odile.design: A 71-year-old retired lycee teacher who has lived in the same Marais flat for forty-one years. Native Parisian French. Clear, precise, cultivated older woman's voice; exacting about politeness, dry wit.

ines.design: A woman in her late twenties in Paris, friendly and easygoing, distracted by a phone call she is waiting for. Native Parisian French. Light, warm, informal.

marcel.design: A Paris baker around fifty, up early every day, who goes to bed at nine. Native French, Parisian accent. Warm, gruff, amused and plain-spoken.

bonjour_man.design: A Paris shopkeeper around sixty who corrects a customer for not saying bonjour. Native Parisian French. Dry, precise, mildly reproachful, not unkind.

paris_elodie.design: A woman around forty who runs a kiosk by a Paris park and has been asked for directions in nine languages. Native Parisian French. Patient, crisp, gently amused.

paris_karim.design: A man in his mid-forties who sells second-hand books from a trestle in Paris, of North African heritage. Native Parisian French. Relaxed, sharp, switches from formal to friendly in one sentence.

viktor.design: A 46-year-old Moscow repair-booth man who mends shoes, zips, keys and watches. Native Russian, Moscow accent. Low, terse, gruff voice of few words, which warms up completely when he talks about football.

alina.design: A woman in her late thirties in Moscow with a grandmother's brooch that needs repairing. Native Russian, Moscow accent. Quiet, firm and private, polite but reserved.

pavel.design: A man around forty in Moscow, talkative and eager, who speaks for other people too readily. Native Russian, Moscow accent. Warm, quick, a bit overbearing, then genuinely apologetic.

moscow_artyom.design: A 33-year-old lift mechanic in Moscow who smiles about twice a year. Native Russian. Flat, low, laconic, helpful without warmth.

moscow_galina.design: A 57-year-old kiosk seller by a Moscow metro station. Native Russian, Moscow accent. Stern, unsmiling, brisk older woman's voice that will help you completely anyway.

hold_man.design: A Moscow man in his mid-forties whose bag strap has just broken, asking a stranger to hold something. Native Russian. Hurried, direct, slightly out of breath.

omkar.design: A 22-year-old man from Mumbai who repairs phones and runs the lane's festival committee. Native Hindi with Mumbai Bambaiya flavour, mixing in English words. Clearly male, medium-low young man's voice; friendly, quick and easygoing, with a grin in it.

asha.design: A woman around forty in Mumbai organising a neighbourhood gathering. Native Hindi, Mumbai accent. Warm, organised, practical and welcoming.

yusuf.design: A delivery man in his mid-forties in a crowded Mumbai lane. Native Hindi, Mumbai accent. Steady, practical, patient, mid-low voice.

mumbai_farid.design: A 54-year-old dealer in brass, clocks and ship salvage at a Mumbai market. Native Hindi mixing in English, Mumbai accent. A man's voice, medium-low and a little gravelly; jovial, quick-talking salesman, not shouting.
mumbai_farid.note: Redesigned 2026-09-30: the first voice measured far outside the brief's pitch range for their gender.

mumbai_sunita.design: A 47-year-old fourth-generation wholesale thread merchant in Mumbai. Native Hindi mixing English, Mumbai accent. Businesslike, sharp, corrects your grammar kindly.

mandal_boy.design: An adult voice actor performing an eager young boy for an animated film, in native Mumbai Hindi: bright, quick, persuasive delivery.
mandal_boy.note: A boy in the game; cast the conventional way, an adult performing a child. If Voice Design refuses, he stays silent.
mandal_boy.unvoiced: ElevenLabs Voice Design refuses to make a child's voice, even as an adult performing one; left silent rather than worked around. Needs a real recording or another service.

setsuko.design: A 74-year-old woman who runs a kitchenware shop on Kappabashi street in Tokyo. Native Japanese, Tokyo accent. Composed, gracious older woman's voice, polite and patient, with a firm edge on the phone.

haru.gender_source: not stated in the game - written without pronouns; cast androgynous
haru.design: An androgynous young adult in their mid-twenties in Tokyo who designs paper displays and dreams of opening a shop. Native Japanese, Tokyo accent. Mid-pitched, soft, gender-neutral voice; casual, curious and gentle.

mori.design: Mr Mori, a regular customer in his early seventies in Tokyo with stiff fingers and firm preferences. Native Japanese, Tokyo accent. Quiet, polite, reserved older man's voice, reassuring in tone.

tokyo_iwata.design: A 62-year-old third-generation second-hand bookshop owner in Tokyo who never refuses outright. Native Japanese, Tokyo accent. Soft, hesitant, very polite, trailing off.

tokyo_sora.gender_source: not stated in the game; cast androgynous
tokyo_sora.design: A 19-year-old art student in Tokyo who talks too much and knows it. Native Japanese, Tokyo accent. Youthful, gender-neutral, lively and slightly awkward.

eating_woman.design: A Tokyo shopkeeper around fifty who politely follows a customer out to say eating while walking is not quite done. Native Japanese. Very polite, indirect, gently embarrassed.

rocio.design: A 45-year-old flower seller from La Merced market in Mexico City, preparing her family's Day of the Dead altar. Native Mexican Spanish, Mexico City accent. Warm, strong, busy and direct.

lucia.design: A woman around thirty in Mexico City who draws what she wants to remember. Native Mexican Spanish, chilango accent. Gentle, thoughtful, curious.

tomas.design: An old man in his mid-seventies in Mexico City who laughs through his grief over a familiar blue cup. Native Mexican Spanish. Warm, slightly cracked older man's voice, tender and funny.

mexico_chuy.design: A 26-year-old man with a juice cart on a Mexico City corner who never says no to anybody. Native Mexican Spanish, chilango accent. Easygoing, friendly, fast.

mexico_pilar.design: Dona Pilar, a 63-year-old herb and dried chilli seller in a Mexico City market who uses diminutives for everything. Native Mexican Spanish. Sweet, motherly, sing-song older woman's voice.

flower_woman.design: A Mexico City woman around fifty with both arms full of flowers asking a stranger to help. Native Mexican Spanish. Hurried, warm, familiar.

dakar_ousmane.design: A 52-year-old tailor in the Medina in Dakar, Senegal, never rushed. Native Wolof speaker who also speaks French with a Senegalese accent. Deep, calm, courteous.

dakar_awa.design: A 36-year-old wax cloth seller in Dakar, Senegal, who will out-greet anybody. Native Wolof speaker who also speaks French with a Senegalese accent. Bright, lively, warm, teasing.

hanoi_duc.design: A 24-year-old motorbike taxi rider in Hanoi. Native Vietnamese, northern Hanoi accent. Casual, quick, friendly young man.

hanoi_hien.design: A 38-year-old woman selling noodles from a plastic stool in Hanoi, endlessly patient about tones. Native Vietnamese, northern Hanoi accent. Patient, clear, warm.

hanoi_lan.design: A 29-year-old woman selling iced tea from a cart by the Hanoi metro. Native Vietnamese, northern Hanoi accent. Light, cheerful, repeats things back clearly.

honolulu_kimo.design: A Native Hawaiian man around forty in Honolulu who lends out surfboards. Speaks Hawaii Pidgin English with a local Hawaiian accent. Relaxed, warm, easygoing.

honolulu_lani.design: A Native Hawaiian woman in her forties in Honolulu who strings leis. Local Hawaiian English accent. Gentle, warm, unhurried.

lapaz_mauricio.design: A 39-year-old cable car operator in La Paz, Bolivia. Native Bolivian Spanish, Andean La Paz accent. Measured, curious, friendly.

lapaz_remedios.design: Dona Remedios, a 64-year-old Aymara market seller of potatoes and dried maize in El Alto, Bolivia. Native Bolivian Spanish with an Andean accent. Firm, skeptical, deliberate older woman's voice.

newyork_dov.design: A New York diner griddle cook in his fifties who has been on since five. Native American English with a strong New York accent. Gruff, fast, no-nonsense.

newyork_marisol.design: A Puerto Rican New Yorker in her forties who runs a newsstand on a busy corner. Native American English with a New York accent. Quick, blunt, streetwise, not unfriendly.

rome_nando.design: A 59-year-old Roman market stall holder, forty years at the same stall. Native Italian with a strong Roman accent. A man's voice, deep and a little hoarse from years of calling out; warm and theatrical, talking over everyone without shrieking.
rome_nando.note: Redesigned 2026-09-30: the first voice measured far outside the brief's pitch range for their gender.

rome_lucia.design: A 44-year-old woman who runs a bar by a market in Rome and serves whoever speaks up. Native Italian, Roman accent. Brisk, sharp, quietly warm.

neusa.design: A 61-year-old hairdresser who has run a salon in Bixiga, Sao Paulo, for thirty-one years. Native Brazilian Portuguese, Sao Paulo accent. Warm, tactile, affectionate, a little bossy.

saopaulo_jandira.design: A 41-year-old shopkeeper in Sao Paulo who stands very close when she talks. Native Brazilian Portuguese, paulistano accent. Warm, friendly, teasing.

saopaulo_wellington.design: A 29-year-old sound engineer in Sao Paulo who touches your arm mid-sentence. Native Brazilian Portuguese, paulistano accent. Laid-back, friendly, slangy.

seoul_baek.design: A 71-year-old owner of a lathe and press workshop in Seoul, in the same unit since 1979. Native Korean, Seoul accent. Gruff, formal, older man's voice who asks your age first.

seoul_jiwon.design: A 31-year-old type designer in Seoul. Native Korean, Seoul accent. Friendly, casual, warm, dropping formality as a gesture of friendship.

sydney_jen.design: A woman in her thirties who works the ferry wharf in Sydney. Native Australian English with a broad Aussie accent. Breezy, friendly, shortens every word.

sydney_thuy.design: A Vietnamese-Australian woman around thirty who grew up in western Sydney and works in an office tower. Native Australian English with a western Sydney accent. Dry, direct, patient.

tbilisi_zurab.design: A 66-year-old Georgian man in Tbilisi who keeps wine in his cellar and runs the table at feasts. Native Georgian, Tbilisi accent. Deep, resonant, ceremonious and warm.

tbilisi_nino.design: A 48-year-old Georgian woman selling cheese and herbs by the Tbilisi station who quietly coaches visitors. Native Georgian. Calm, kind, low voice.

toronto_priya.design: A Canadian woman of South Asian heritage in her late twenties who rides a Toronto streetcar twice a day. Native Canadian English, Toronto accent. Polite, apologetic, friendly.

toronto_wes.design: A Toronto shopkeeper around sixty, third generation in the same front room. Native Canadian English. Easygoing, understated, kind.

beat.design: A 34-year-old man who runs a newspaper kiosk in Zurich. Native Swiss German speaker, Zurich dialect, switching awkwardly into standard High German for foreigners. Friendly, a bit shy, precise.

zurich_ruedi.design: A 46-year-old Zurich tram driver. Native Swiss German, broad Zurich dialect. Easy, matter-of-fact, unhurried.

zurich_frau_amsler.design: Frau Amsler, a 68-year-old kiosk owner in Zurich who speaks four languages. Native Swiss German, Zurich dialect. Crisp, brisk, precise older woman's voice.
